rows.en: You reached the target area. That's the end of Special Maneuvers training.
Time's up. That's the end of Special Maneuvers training.
Finally, the last explanation. I have nothing left to regret. All that's left is to burn out.
All there is now is explanation, and me. So, my...
rows.notes: Parody of her song line; continues into she_891.

rows.en: ...Listen to the explanation!
You probably know this without my saying so, but during training the controller settings are reset to default.
When an enemy missile has you targeted, a missile marker appears on the screen.
When the missile marker turns red, you can shoot down the enemy missile.
In Fighter mode and on some machines, the Anti-Missile Action scatters flares to bring down enemy missiles.
The targets will launch missiles, so train the Anti-Missile Action.
You reached the target area. That's the end of Anti-Missile Action training.
Time's up. That's the end of Anti-Missile Action training.
This is enough. I have nothing left to regret. All that's left is to burn out.

rows.notes: Vajra voice; transcript is nonsense syllables ("listener, listener, Eifos, bird person").

rows.en: I'll help too. Fighting creates nothing.
Singing songs of war can't be my only role.
I'm an Emulator, a song priestess who leads to victory.
I want to sing for everyone. The song of Ars.
rows.notes: "Ars" (Arusu) is the Mardook-side culture/star word; not in the glossary.

rows.en: We should be able to understand each other. Why must we fight?
No... to protect our culture, there's no choice but to fight.
Amazing! So this is the power of Ars!
I'm sure you can lead the way.
So this is the power that ends fighting.
Why are you doing this?
Run away! At this rate, you'll...
Stop it! Don't do anything worse than this!
I'm sorry, because of me.
rows.notes: Seems to trail off; kept as heard.

rows.en: No... how terrible...
Everything is going to be destroyed.
You listen too, to my song.
Thank you. Now we should be able to put an end to the fighting.
This is the power of Ars. We can understand each other, after all.
To build a new culture, I can't stop here.
Protecting culture and handing it down is a wonderful thing.
I just want everyone to hear all kinds of songs.
This is the Emulator's duty.
I'll try!
I entrust the power of Ars to you.
Understood.
Yes!

rows.notes: Transcript is "SUS" (a sound, 0.7 s), probably a breath or a very short "hai".

rows.en: Captain, fall back!
At this rate, the Captain...
Captain, listen to my song. Calm down.
To think the Captain has ended up like this.
It's because of my war song.
There's nothing to gain from destruction...
Thanks to the Captain, I can sing with peace of mind.
Thank you, Captain.
The war song... the Emulator's duty.
The war song, the Emulator's duty.
Why? I don't enjoy singing for you at all.
I'm sorry. I don't want to be with you.
Do you really have a culture?
It's thanks to you that this operation succeeded.
I'll keep relying on you.
I'm truly grateful that you helped me.
Thank you, always. I look forward to working with you.
I can't put my gratitude into words. Next time, please listen to my song.
With you, I feel we could build a new culture.
I want to sing a love song for you.
So this is love. It feels so strange.
I want to tell you more. Many songs, and my heart.
I don't want to be with someone who doesn't know the sorrow of destruction.
Please think again about what culture is.
My song doesn't reach you, does it.
As expected. It seems you made it a success.
It succeeded because you worked so hard.
Thank you for helping me.
Even a song that isn't for battle can help you, can't it.
I wonder if my song really reached you.
Sing with me. The song of the star Ars.
rows.notes: "Ars" not in glossary; "Ars no hoshi" taken as "the star Ars".

rows.en: I'm glad you're safe. I can sing songs of happy times again.
What kind of love songs do you sing? Teach me sometime.
I wanted to tell you. My precious feelings, to you.
The ship of Ars!
Feff!
...Feff.
rows.notes: Heard "Dangu berude Fefu"; the first words look like garbled Mardook speech, only the name Feff kept.

rows.en: We must not fight. We must not destroy this planet.
I am Ishtar, Emulator of the Mardook.
rows.notes: Heard "Yushitaru Maruryuku"; read as Ishtar of the Mardook.
